_comment: Off to the Mill: the opening's handoff and the first `reach` quest. Flora offers it once `meat-for-dinner` is complete; `road` is done the first tick the player stands inside the `farmreinhard` region (api/regions/regions.json), not while flying; `meet` is turned in on Reinhard's root row 'Flora sends me. I'm looking for work.' No reward: it is a handoff, and his own quests follow. No marker of any kind points at the farm (gdd.md §42). The id keeps its old name so saved progress stays valid.
title: Off to the Mill

stages.journal: Flora has no more work. She told you to talk to miller Reinhard, who lives further east.
You have reached Reinhard's farm. Now to find the miller himself.
You told Reinhard that Flora sent you. There is plenty of work around here.
